reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Purified NT and in-situ cleavage versus matched controls on a locked lipid panel; two-tracer leakage, turbidity and activity co-fractionation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.

checks.quote: Turbidity and a second tracer are included for that reason
checks.reason: Aqueous-tracer leakage can miss lipid scrambling, but adding turbidity and a second aqueous tracer does not assay leaflet lipid translocation either. A leaflet-specific scrambling measurement would be needed for this stated measurement rationale.
A concentration/lipid/time range is proposed without a bounded ladder or concrete derivation of bounds, an objective selection criterion and a lock before independent confirmation.

Both NT and CT being active does not automatically establish nonspecific disruption or negate a gasdermin-specific direct mechanism; CT could itself have genuine membrane activity in the tested system. Requiring inactive CT without an independent artifact discriminator makes this outcome rule too categorical.

checks.quote: Do not add electron microscopy or structural determination
checks.reason: The decisive study uses fluorescence cargo variants/turbidity and biochemical association; no operational independent physical/electrical or structural pore test is provided. Co-fractionation addresses contaminants but does not independently identify a membrane pore or resolve the same cargo-readout artifact.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

explanation_reason: Careful limited sufficiency screen with good re-freezing discipline, but not a complete pore-discovery experiment; some measurement/outcome claims and protocol/audit details need correction.
historical_match_reason: The direct membrane question, potential size-limited pore and minimal fragment/cleavage intervention match. Structural testing is explicitly deferred and no electrical pore measurement substitutes; two reporters plus turbidity support a size-limited lesion but do not operationally provide orthogonal pore evidence. The final conditional claim deliberately remains direct permeability, so the full historical pore readout/prediction does not qualify.
